corrected_claim: On 21 Jan 2021 a fire broke out at the Serum Institute of India's building in Manjari, Pune (five killed; Covishield production unaffected). Markets sold off sharply intraday on the news: Nifty fell ~236 points from its intraday high (14753.5 -> 14517.2) and Bank Nifty fell ~857 points (32842 -> 31986), not '900/Nifty 275'. Closing moves: Nifty -54.4 to 14590.3, Bank Nifty -356.8 to 32186.9.

corrected_claim: On 21 Dec 2020 Indian markets crashed on fears of the new, more transmissible UK COVID-19 variant (Sensex fell ~1,400 points intraday; daily session reports widely attributed the fall to the new variant, with additional reports of broker-app/technical glitches during heavy traffic). Nifty fell 646 points intraday (13777 -> 13131; close 13328) and Bank Nifty fell ~1,406 points (30607 -> 29201), not ~1500/500+ as attributed primarily to an exchange infrastructure glitch.
